turns.query: Build a common-economy retrospective screen using 2025-Q4 BIS all-lender private-nonfinancial-sector actual credit-to-GDP and actual-minus-trend credit gap, reported household, non-financial-corporate and private-nonfinancial-sector debt-service ratios, and broad nominal and real effective-exchange-rate indexes for 2024-12 and 2025-12. Retain economies with actual credit-to-GDP of at least 100%, reported private-sector DSR of at least 15%, and a negative percentage change in the real EER. Rank the retained economies by nominal EER percentage change from most negative upward, breaking a tie by display economy name ascending. Report the common count, retained count, selected economy and the runner-up change minus the selected change. Explain the joint condition represented by the selection.

For the economy selected above, report its 2025-Q4 actual credit-to-GDP ratio and actual-minus-trend credit gap. Within the fixed common population from the prior turn, also report its descending ranks on actual credit and on the credit gap, breaking ties by display economy name ascending. Explain the level-versus-gap position.

Carry the selected economy into a DSR structure check. Report household, non-financial-corporate and reported private-nonfinancial-sector DSRs in 2024-Q4 and 2025-Q4 and each signed change. Separately calculate the arithmetic mean of the two 2025-Q4 sector DSRs and compare the reported private-sector DSR with it. Explain what the comparison says about constructing the private-sector aggregate.

Finally, report the selected economy's broad nominal and real EER index levels for 2024-12 and 2025-12 and each percentage change. Within the original common population, rank nominal and real percentage changes separately from most negative upward with display economy name ascending as tie-break. Explain the nominal-versus-real path.
